LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Setup.LetterText:
Crew, your away mission is to establish a secure perimeter, deploy the subspace sensor array, and survey two alien obelisks detected from orbit.
1) Build and power a Subspace Sensor near each obelisk. 2) Perform a scan on both obelisks. 3) Consolidate the telemetry at the beacon and transmit to Starfleet.
Operational note: Local fauna exhibits irregular bioelectric responses to subspace harmonics. Once the uplink energizes the ionosphere, agitation events are likely. Remain alert and protect the equipment.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Spawned.Title: Obelisks located
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Spawned.Text: We have pinpointed two alien obelisks on this world. Their surface glyphs map to an unknown pre-warp symbology. Establish the sensors and begin scans.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanA.OrderText: Bring the Subspace Sensor online near the first obelisk and start a deep-field scan. Post a security cordon—wildlife may react to the ping.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanA.SuccessText: The first obelisk’s harmonic lattice is mapped. Proceed to the second site and repeat the procedure.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanB.OrderText: Power the sensor near the second obelisk and complete the scan to finish the local survey.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.ScanB.SuccessText: We now hold paired datasets of harmonic glyph patterns. Consolidate the results and transmit to Starfleet from the communications beacon.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Transmit.OrderText: Use the beacon’s “Report to Starfleet” function to uplink the consolidated obelisk data. Expect local fauna agitation once the broadcast energizes the ionosphere.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Transmit.SentText: Starfleet confirms receipt. Preliminary analysis underway. Maintain a defensive posture until local conditions stabilize.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Impulse.FaunaText: Subspace emission has rippled through the ecosystem, triggering aggressive behavior in nearby wildlife. Brace for contact.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Manhunt.Title: Faunal disturbance
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Manhunt.Text: The broadcast has agitated nearby wildlife. Hold the line and protect the equipment until the disturbance passes.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseII.CompleteText: Immediate threats have passed. Starfleet has enough data to model the window—awaiting your recommendation on how to proceed with the sites.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.ThreatText: Residual harmonics continue to agitate local fauna. Expect another attack while the window stabilizes.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase III
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIII.Desc: Directive required. The subspace window is stable for now. Choose whether to secure the sites under Starfleet protocol or make a decisive push to reach the presumed vault before claimants converge.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Choice.Title: Directive required
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.Choice.Text:
Option A — Warden protocol: Establish jurisdiction, deter interference, and hold the sites for controlled study.
Option B — Vault recovery: Move fast. If the obelisks are markers, a cache or vault may exist. Rivals and profiteers won’t wait.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase IV (Warden)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.Desc: Impose the Warden’s protocol and secure the sites against interference. Expect a retaliatory raid by local interests.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.LetterText: By authority of Starfleet, the obelisk sites are now restricted. Establish checkpoints, warn off claimants, and repel any force that attempts to breach the perimeter.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseIV.DoneText: The area is stabilized under Warden rules. Starfleet will dispatch a research tender when the window fully collapses.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Title: Obelisk Survey — Phase V (Vault)
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.Desc: Race claimants to the presumed vault and recover its contents before the window attracts more attention.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.LetterText: Our models triangulate a likely cache within ground-penetrating range of the obelisk pair. Move quickly. Expect resistance from opportunists tracking our signals.
LanguageData.STQ.Obelisks.PhaseV.DoneText: The vault has been cleared and its artifacts secured. Catalog the finds and prepare them for Starfleet custody.
